key_insight: Feature-fused 3-D active vision automatically extracts V-groove welding trajectories on reflective materials while suppressing reflection interference.
engineering_relevance: The method supports automated weld-path generation where reflective surfaces complicate laser-based seam detection.
method: Segment weld-seam laser stripes using the saliency feature fusion model SFF_LSM.
Extract stripe centers using a gray-gravity algorithm with secondary smoothing.
Filter seam point clouds and fit welding trajectories using least squares.
evidence_signal: Experiments reported maximum trajectory fitting errors of 0.51 mm in X, 0.40 mm in Y, and 0.29 mm in Z.
watch_item: The abstract addresses planar welds; performance on nonplanar seams or under different reflection conditions remains unestablished.
paper_title: Automatic extraction of welding trajectories for V-groove welds based on 3-D active vision imaging
